name: FoundationDB Open-Source Distributed Database
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source transactional distributed ordered key-value database with ACID transactions, multi-node deployment and no vendor-enforced query, user or storage quota for self-hosting.
watch_out: You must operate servers, disks, cluster coordination, backups, security and monitoring; infrastructure and optional commercial support are not included. Follow Apache-2.0 license notice requirements; this is not a free managed FoundationDB cloud instance.
